01 · The story

A name attached to ideas, work and a journey.

Emmanuel Odeleye is building a distinctive path at the intersection of science, technology, leadership and student-driven innovation — combining curiosity, initiative and a strong commitment to creating opportunities for the next generation.

This gallery brings the person behind the projects into focus: formal moments, work, community, learning and everyday snapshots that make a professional story feel real.

As the Founder of Humanex Global, Emmanuel is developing a community built around science, learning, innovation and collaboration.

Emmanuel also serves as Assistant Academic Director of NIMELSA, KolaDaisi University Chapter, for the 2026/2027 academic session, contributing to an environment where students can learn, connect and grow.
